description: State Machine Model Checker — Returns PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE for a finite state machine, protocol, or concurrent routine, with the shortest failing path as readable process.transition steps and a next step. Accepts a formal spec (no LLM), a plain-language workflow, or source code (translated to a spec by an LLM, with every transition quoted from the source and two independent translations compared). A pure TypeScript expli

code.description: Source code of a state machine, protocol, or concurrent routine; translated to a spec by an LLM, with each transition carrying its verbatim source span.

description.description: Natural-language workflow or protocol; translated to a spec by an LLM, with each transition quoted from the text.

deadlock.description: Report deadlocks (non-terminal states with no enabled transition). Default true.

explain.description: Add a plain-language explanation of the computed result (property verdicts, counterexample steps, final state), built from the result itself with no model call. Default false.

livelock.description: Report fair cycles that never reach a progress or terminal state; needs a progress or terminal predicate. Default true when the spec has a progress predicate.

maxMillis.description: Total wall-clock budget in ms for exploration plus liveness analysis (default 8000). On description/code input the three budgets are split evenly between the two translated models.

properties.description: Properties to check, in plain language (with description or code only).

spec.description: Formal spec (zero LLM calls). {vars:{name:{type:'bool'|'int'|'enum'|'array',min,max,values,size|keys,of,init}}, processes:[{name,instances?,fairness?:'none'|'weak'|'strong',transitions:[{name,guard?,updates:[{var,at?,value}]}]}], initWhere?, terminal?, progress?, invariants:[{name,expr}], liveness:[{name,kind:'eventually'|'alwaysEventually'|'leadsTo',p,q?}]}. Expressions are JSON nodes ({var,at?}, {sym}, {param}, {op,args}, forall/exists) or infix strings such as "pc[self] == wait && !flag[1 - self]"; nothing is evaluated as code.

name: state-model-checker
